observation.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
with open('compose.yaml') as f:
    content = f.read()
# Remove the deploy.resources blocks (only active ones are under streamlet & valhalla)
new, n = re.subn(r"    deploy:\n      resources:\n        reservations:\n          cpus: \"[0-9]+\"\n          memory: \S+\n        limits:\n          cpus: \"[0-9]+\"\n          memory: \S+\n", "", content)
print("removed blocks:", n)
with open('compose.yaml','w') as f:
    f.write(new)
EOF
grep -n "deploy:" compose.yaml
